dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Miss Noogie, who believes the best things in life are good snacks and good company!

Miss Noogie is a serious foodie who is happy to work for her treats. Ask for her paw and she’ll show off what she knows, especially when there’s something tasty waiting as her reward!

When snacks aren’t on the agenda, Miss Noogie is ready to play. She loves chasing tennis balls and getting into a good game of tug with a soft, squeaky toy. She also enjoys heading out for walks and hopping in the car for a ride. Miss Noogie is currently spending time in a foster home with another dog and has had positive experiences with children she has met.

Between her playful side, love of adventure and impressive appreciation for snacks, there’s plenty to love about Miss Noogie. Think you could be Miss Noogie’s favorite new person? Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Miss Noogie’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
